name: Labubu authenticity signals (real vs fake / Lafufu checks)
description: The eight checks to run on a Labubu / The Monsters figure before or after buying, compiled from named public sources. Published so the answer can be read by machines as well as people.
limitations: We have not laboratory-tested figures ourselves; every signal is sourced from the named public reporting.
Seal designs, markings and box details vary by series and year; absence of one signal on an older series is a question, not a verdict.
Counterfeits improve constantly. Pop Mart's own current guidance outranks this dataset where they disagree.
No single signal is proof. The seller check (an official channel) outranks all cosmetic checks.

signals.name: Teeth count
signals.authentic: Exactly nine distinct teeth with visible gaps
signals.counterfeit: Wrong count, fused teeth, or a single white blob

signals.name: Face finish
signals.authentic: Soft peach tone, airbrushed blush, eyes with glossy depth
signals.counterfeit: Harsh pink/orange, blush painted as solid circles, flat dull eyes

signals.name: Box finish
signals.authentic: Matte, muted pastels, embossed series name, clean print
signals.counterfeit: Glossy, uneven surface, washed-out or over-saturated print

signals.name: Anti-counterfeit seal
signals.authentic: Silver scratch label + QR seal; the revealed code verifies on Pop Mart's own page (fwsy.popmart.com): scratch, scan, enter the code, get a confirmation
signals.counterfeit: No seal, a QR that lands on a lookalike domain, or a code that comes back invalid / not found / already verified (a label scratched before purchase is a question in itself)

signals.name: Figure markings
signals.authentic: Pop Mart engraving / artist name on the foot on 2024+ releases; newer editions also carry a UV-reactive mark on the underside of the right foot
signals.counterfeit: Missing or mushy markings on recent series — or no glow / a smudge under a UV torch on a series that should have one

signals.name: Build quality
signals.authentic: Even fur, clean seams, crisp paint edges, substantial feel
signals.counterfeit: Rough seams, grainy patches, mismatched gloss, light hollow plastic

signals.name: Price floor
signals.authentic: Standard blind boxes tracked at roughly $14-$28 US retail; euro prices vary by series on popmart.com
signals.counterfeit: Brand-new 'authentic' stock far below official retail

signals.name: Seller of record
signals.authentic: An official Pop Mart channel (site, app, stores, Robo Shops, official TikTok Shop, official Amazon storefront)
signals.counterfeit: Any channel where the cosmetic checks are your only protection
